description.value: Hush is the weekend coffee alter-ego of COFU Chinatown, a celebrated plant-based Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown neighbourhood. The space offers specialty beans from Japanese roaster Hiyori, ceremonial-grade Uji matcha and hojicha from Kyoto, house-made sweets, and a short cocktail list. It shares the refined, quietly intentional atmosphere of the COFU brand, which earned national television recognition for its innovative fully plant-based omakase.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /hush subpage confirms Hush is an active weekend coffee concept operating from COFU Chinatown at 488 Gore Avenue, serving Japanese specialty coffee, matcha/hojicha, house-made sweets, and cocktails on Saturdays and Sundays. The phone number (604) 336-1166 and address match OSM exactly. The FAQ page explicitly states 'COFU Chinatown is proudly 100% vegan,' and since Hush shares the same physical space and brand, this applies. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (06:30-12:00) does not match the website, which states Saturday & Sunday 9:30 AM – 2:30 PM. The OSM hours appear to be incorrect or carried over from a different operation at the same address.
Hush is a weekend-only concept (Saturday & Sunday); cyclists visiting on weekdays will find it closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible weekend café with a confirmed address, phone, and active website. A useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's Chinatown.
enrichment_extras.notes: Hush is a distinct weekend concept nested within the COFU Chinatown location; it is not a separate physical premises. The OSM record correctly points to the dedicated /hush subpage.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states 'COFU Chinatown is proudly 100% vegan'; Hush operates from the same location under the same brand. FAQ also notes gluten-free accommodation is available
